def get_number():
    import sys
    num = 0
    c = sys.stdin.read(1)
    while c and ord(c) < 33:
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
    while c and ord(c) > 33:
        num = num * 10 + (ord(c) - ord('0'))
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
    return num

def main():
    import sys
    x_val = get_number()
    y_val = get_number()
    total = get_number()

    numerator = 0
    denominator = 1

    for index in range(1, total + 1):
        p = x_val * index // y_val
        q = p + 1
        diff = index * abs(x_val * denominator - numerator * y_val)
        t1 = denominator * abs(x_val * index - y_val * p)
        t2 = denominator * abs(x_val * index - y_val * q)

        if t1 < diff:
            numerator = p
            denominator = index
            diff = t1
        if t2 < diff:
            numerator = q
            denominator = index
            diff = t2

    print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
